verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
By the Fig and the Olive,

verses.ar: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ فِیۡۤ اَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِیۡمٍ ۫﴿۵﴾
verses.en: [✲]Surely, We have created man in the best make;
[✲]Then, if he works iniquity, We reject him as the lowest of the low,

verses.ar: اِلَّا الَّذِیۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَلَہُمۡ اَجۡرٌ غَیۡرُ مَمۡنُوۡنٍ ؕ﴿۷﴾
verses.en: Except those who believe and do good works; so for them is an unending reward.
Then what is there to give the lie to thee after this with regard to the Judgment?
w: is there to give the lie to thee

verses.en: Is not Allah the Best of judges?
